20+ years, same name

BlueSky has been renovating homes across York Region for more than twenty years — long enough that most new work still comes from someone who's already had us in their house.

One project at a time

We don't run five jobs at once. Your renovation gets the crew's full attention from demolition to the final coat of paint.

Jamie is on site

The person who quotes your job is the person running it. No account manager, no rotating cast of strangers in your hallway.

What we do

Renovations, start to finish.

Full-service work on the rooms people actually live in. If it involves framing, drywall, tile, cabinetry or trim, it's probably something we've done a hundred times.

Kitchens

Layout changes, cabinetry, quartz counters, tile, lighting and appliance fit. Handled as one job so you're not coordinating five trades yourself.

Get a quote →

Bathrooms

Full gut renovations, walk-in showers, freestanding tubs, heated floors and vanities. Waterproofing done properly, because that's the part you never see.

Get a quote →

Basement finishing

Framing, insulation, permits, egress, bathrooms, kitchenettes and in-law suites. We turn the storage floor into the best room in the house.

Get a quote →

Custom carpentry

Built-in benches, shelving, mudrooms, wall panelling and fireplace surrounds. Built on site to fit the room you actually have.

Get a quote →

Whole-home renovations

Opening up main floors, moving walls, flooring, trim and paint throughout. Larger projects where sequencing matters more than anything.

Get a quote →

Something else?

Additions, decks, laundry rooms, garage conversions, accessibility work. If you're not sure whether it's something we do, just ask — Jamie will tell you straight.

Who you're hiring

Jamie runs the job.

One project at a time isn't a slogan. It's the only way one crew can properly finish what it starts.

BlueSky is a small, family-run renovation company working across York Region — Newmarket, Aurora, Richmond Hill, King, Bradford and everywhere in between. Jamie has been doing this for more than twenty years, and almost every job still comes by word of mouth: a neighbour, a coworker, someone whose basement we finished six years ago.

That means the work has to be right, because the next job depends on it. You get a written quote with the scope spelled out, a crew that shows up, and a walkthrough at the end where we fix anything that isn't finished properly before you pay the balance.

Book a walkthrough

How it works

Four steps, no surprises.

1

Walkthrough

Jamie comes to your home, looks at the space, and talks through what you're picturing. Free, and there's no pitch at the end of it.

2

Written quote

You get the scope in writing — what's included, what's not, and what it costs. If something's likely to change, we tell you before you sign, not after.

3

The build

One crew, your project, start to finish. Site cleaned at the end of each day, and you always know what's happening tomorrow.

4

Final walkthrough

We go through the space together and list anything that needs fixing. It gets fixed before the final invoice, not after.
